metadata.description: ModelScout: the right AI model for every task. It shows which model fits and why, then routes the work to it.

plugins.name: modelscout
plugins.description: Shows which AI model fits each task and why, then routes it to a best-fit subagent (or asks, or stays, per your defaults) — grounded in the models your keys and subscriptions can actually access, with live pricing. Saves API users money and saves subscribers tokens and rate-limit quota.
